description: This file contains a React hook 'useLogFilterLogic' that manages filter state, performs client and server-side filtering, and handles data fetching and debouncing for logs in a dashboard UI. It defines filter keys, manages filter states, performs API calls, and provides filtered log data, along with related auxiliary functions and constants.

methods.name: useLogFilterLogic
